title: cystopteris tenuis
intro: Cystopteris tenuis, commonly known as Cinnamon Fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris tenuis include its use as a diuretic, to treat urinary tract infections, and as a demulcent, to soothe and protect mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
